Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 149. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 25x ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Super Ghost Guardians
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self (5 feet)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: 1 minute (concentration)
Type: Omni
The user spits out a number of identical ghost
versions of themselves up to or equal to half of their
proficiency bonus.
The Ghosts float harmlessly around you for the
duration. Whenever you are subject to an attack roll you
may sacrifice a ghost to take the hit and explode,
dealing 3d10 Ki damage to all creatures but yourself
within 5 feet.
These ghosts count toward the count for the
“Ultimate Ghost Kamikaze” Technique.
Super Boo Kamikaze Attack
AlexelZ
